close_reason: SSE Content-Type prefix check now compares the media-type essence exactly per RFC 7231 §3.1.1.1 / RFC 9110 §8.3 (split on ';' or whitespace, then compare). Two regression tests added: streamish-suffix rejected, charset=utf-8 parameter accepted. Workspace tests green.
description: src/client.rs:404 — `if !ct.starts_with("text/event-stream")` accepts any media type whose lowercased value begins with that string, e.g. "text/event-streamish" or "text/event-stream2". Per RFC 7231 §3.1.1.1 and RFC 9110 §8.3 the media-type subtype is bounded by ';', SP, HTAB, or end-of-string. Trigger: a misconfigured server returning Content-Type: text/event-streamish — the prefix check passes, the parser silently produces no events, and the caller sees an apparently-quiet stream. Fix: split on first ';' or whitespace and compare the trimmed essence to "text/event-stream" exactly. Low-likelihood trigger, but the cost of the fix is small.
